comments: Built on the axe-core rules engine (Deque, MPL 2.0) run in a real Chromium browser via Playwright, so JavaScript-rendered SPA content is evaluated. The full-site crawl covers up to 50 pages and respects robots.txt; requests are rate-limited per IP and per target domain. We state on the tool that automated testing catches roughly 30–40% of WCAG issues and does not replace a manual expert audit. A self-assessed VPAT 2.5 conformance report for the tool is published at https://ost.agency/legal/wcag-tool-vpat/
features: Free, cloud-hosted scanner that audits a single page or an entire website (up to 50 pages) against WCAG 2.0, 2.1 and 2.2 at Levels A and AA. Built on the open-source axe-core engine in a real Chromium browser via Playwright, so JavaScript-rendered content is evaluated. Single-page scans are instant; full-site scans are emailed.
title: OST WCAG Accessibility Checker
